handback.title: A repo with no tests yet passes its test checks
handback.summary: A repo with no tests yet passes the baseline and the all tests check, and the run says so.
handback.feature: A repo with no tests yet passes the baseline and the all tests check, and each run says the repo has no tests yet.

stories.title: The baseline passes on a repo with no tests
stories.user_story: An owner with no tests yet sees the baseline pass, told the repo has no tests yet.
stories.task: Treat no tests collected as an empty baseline in the testmon baseline, and say so on the run.
stories.context: testmon.yml's baseline step tolerates only pytest exit 1, so exit 5 (no tests collected) fails it, then the no .testmondata step fails too. Main now runs it over the TESTS_DIR folder (#877). Pull request #882 fixed it and clashed with that line; its tests/test_no_tests_yet.py runs the job on an empty tests folder through tests/test_settings_workflows.py's Box with real pytest.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the baseline runs on a repo with no tests, it succeeds and saves an empty baseline.
acceptance_criteria.words: treat "no tests collected" as an empty baseline, not a crash, in the testmon baseline

edge_cases.case: Collecting the tests crashes: the baseline still fails.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the baseline runs on a repo with no tests, the run shows a notice saying so.
acceptance_criteria.words: say on the run that the repo has no tests yet

edge_cases.case: A repo with one passing test: no such notice.

stories.title: The all tests check passes with no tests
stories.user_story: An owner with no tests yet sees the all tests check pass, told the repo has no tests yet.
stories.task: Treat no tests collected as success in the all tests check, and say so on the run.
stories.context: full-suite.yml's all-tests step ends with eval "$RUN_ALL", so pytest exit 5 fails the check. Pull request #882 caught exit 5 there with a No tests yet notice; its tests/test_no_tests_yet.py runs the all-tests job on an empty tests folder through tests/test_settings_workflows.py's Box with real pytest.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the all tests check runs on a repo with no tests, it succeeds.
acceptance_criteria.words: wherever the full suite would hit the same exit code

edge_cases.case: Collecting the tests crashes: the check still fails.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the all tests check runs on a repo with no tests, the run shows a notice saying so.
acceptance_criteria.words: say on the run that the repo has no tests yet

edge_cases.case: A repo with one passing test: no such notice.
